anchor_effects: +20 max mana (Band of Starpower); automatic mana potions (Mana Flower)
value_note: USER-SET 2026-10-29 (the three effects and the 15%). With Mechanist gear the tank (10-65 steam) works as extra mana for a mage or a hybrid; overheat immunity removes the class's harshest drawback, so it is an Expert-only reward on purpose. A mana cost the tank covers shows as 0 mana in tooltips (vanilla shows GetManaCost). My calls: whole-cost payment (steam pays a cast only if it covers all of it), 1:1.
